glass.title: Walking on Broken Glass: Crunching on tiny pieces of glass, medium paced walking, stepping on glass with shoes. Recorded with ZoomH6, with rifle microphone, EQ used to reduce background noise.
glass.author: RileyB711
glass.processing: Mono; 65Hz highpass, gentle 6.5kHz rolloff; RMS 0.045, peak capped .68; 6ms in/45ms out; each cut from t-.12 to t+.40. Actual recorded glass footsteps, no synthesis.

hard.author: florianreichelt
hard.processing: Existing recorded steps remastered with same filtering and loudness as glass; see NightSoundscape/sources.json for original provenance.
